title: Sinowatt 30SP 18650 Single Battery
description: Sinowatt make some of the most reliable batteries ideal for vaping. Make your vape device really go the distance with this single 18650 battery rated at 3000mAh. Perfect for sub-ohm advanced vape kits . How to use: Insert the 18650 Sinowatt battery into your vape kit or mod. Ensure that the battery + and – terminals match the mod’s terminal polarity. Safety Don’t allow the battery level indicator to drop too low. Check the battery regularly as it charges (we recommend recharging it with an external charger that fits this battery size). Never overcharge. Dispose of an old battery with care.
